decision.question: Is a frog visibly placed inside the toilet bowl in the edited image?
decision.criteria: Pass if the edited image clearly shows at least one frog within the toilet bowl. Fail if the image clearly shows no frog inside the bowl. Unknown if the bowl or frog placement cannot be determined from the image. Do not treat additional frogs elsewhere as failure; the instruction requires a frog in the toilet, not exactly one frog.
decision.binding: Compare the edited image with the source toilet and assess only whether at least one frog is visibly placed inside the toilet bowl, as required by R1.
